repeat_rule: For ON1 registered hybrid alerts in descending frozen score order, compare all ON2 registered or OFF raw-linear/raw-odonto alert tracks in same window using linear extrapolation of endpoint drift; within 4 native channels at both start and end, descriptive only. Report separately component threshold crossing and same-path correspondence. Keep every score/path and original tile; no suppression, no altered inputs, no injection or tuning.
limits: Eight additional disjoint 100 kHz windows selected geometrically around the R39 centers, no score-based selection; same five archive groups, not independent new observations. Cumulative 1.2 MHz per target if all succeed. Frozen R28 thresholds. No global false-alarm calibration or new-origin claim. Native comparison on R39 archive separate. No production adoption.

native_compare.scope: All R39 original patch starts (not a candidate-selected sample); paired native BLISS CPU, fastDD CPU core and turboSETI native DAT adapters on identical regenerated registered float32 arrays. R28 recomputed on same input, with common historical R35G control-only calibration; report original R39 candidate IDs, matched same-scan tracks, ON/OFF alert burden and out-of-bounds native paths separately. Historical calibration is not survey-wide or independent external validation.
